events.title: v.DEMO.056 Patch Notes
events.summary: v.DEMO.056The dialogue for the start of the journey, the first acquisition of an equipment Thoughtform, and the first encounter with a fiend has been shortened by 2 lines.The dialogue for the first encounter with a chest and the reminder dialogue for the Shop will no longer appear.For those who have already seen these dialogues, they can still be viewed in the Archive as dummy data.Fixed a bug with dragging equipment items.Fixed a typo in the Japanese tutorial regarding Dream-Enhancing Stones.

events.title: v.DEMO.055b Patch Note
events.summary: v.DEMO.055b Fixed a bug with dragging equipment items.

events.title: v.DEMO.055 Patch Notes
events.summary: v.DEMO.055A green crosshair now appears when hovering over an item.The font size of the numbers indicating attack success chances has been increased by 20%.Fixed a typo in the numerical value in the description of Memory of Life.

events.title: v.DEMO.054 Patch Notes
events.summary: v.DEMO.054A log has been added to conversations!You can now view all previous conversations through the log!- The final cutscene of the demo version has been added.With this, I intend to wrap up the demo version once again.I'd like to thank everyone who has continued to enjoy the demo version.I sincerely hope to see you all again with the full release...!

events.title: v.DEMO.052 Patch Note
events.summary: v.DEMO.052Japanese language support has been added!You can now switch the game language to Japanese in the Settings menu, and Japanese is now available as a language option when launching the game for the first time.After selecting a language on the first launch, the explanations for the remaining settings will now be displayed in the selected language.Fixed various text typos and text size issues.Fixed an issue where some item numbers in the Archive were displayed incorrectly.

events.title: v.DEMO.051 Patch Notes
events.summary: v.DEMO.051Act 3 can now be played all the way to its final stage.Since the game's release has been delayed to October–November, and many players have been waiting for the full version, I have decided to fully unlock Act 3. events.title: Scheduled to Exhibit at PlayX4 Korea
events.summary: Hello! I’m Photon, the developer of Warrior Is Just Going.I’m excited to announce that our game will be participating in PlayX4, so I wanted to share this announcement with everyone!Although we’ll only be there for two days, I hope we’ll get the chance to meet many players.See you there!
